# VinylDeck
> Cross-platform desktop app that renders the active system media session as a cinematic vinyl deck on Windows (SMTC) and Linux (MPRIS).

## Primary Docs
- `README.md`: install, features, usage, build from source, troubleshooting
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: setup, conventions, verification, pull requests
- `docs/USER_GUIDE.md`: controls, window modes, Crate, Wrapped, settings, overlay, presence
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: platform adapters, state ownership, services, lifecycle
- `docs/API.md`: Tauri command/event contracts
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`: setup, commands, rootless sysroot, packaging
- `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`: runtime, installer and platform issues
- `docs/RELEASING.md`: tag workflow, stable artifact names, manual validation
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release history in Keep a Changelog format

## Install
- Windows: `irm https://github.com/Shelldock1/vinyldeck/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex`
- Linux: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/Shelldock1/vinyldeck/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash`
- Artifacts: `vinyldeck-setup-windows-x64.exe`, `vinyldeck-windows-x64.msi`, `vinyldeck-linux-x64.AppImage`, `vinyldeck-linux-x64.deb`

## Core Concepts
- One React engine; Rust owns native integration and durable state.
- `media/platform.rs` selects SMTC on Windows and MPRIS on Linux; unsupported targets use neutral stubs.
- Browser mode uses `MockSource`; Tauri mode uses `TauriSource` over Rust commands and events.
- Rust owns settings (`settings.json`), the Crate and play history (`collection.json`), sleep timers and the media poller.
- Start At Login uses the Tauri autostart plugin: registry Run key on Windows, XDG autostart on Linux.
- Mini Transparency is Mini-only; Windows uses Acrylic, Linux depends on the compositor.
- Active shells are Noir and Glass; Light/Dark/Halloween are schemes. Legacy Aurora/Vapor/Paper values are migration inputs only.
- CSS vinyl renderer is active; the center spindle hole is intentionally absent.
- Album art drives ambient color, vinyl material and wear.
- CI and releases build both Ubuntu and Windows; tags publish stable, version-free asset names.

## Important Paths
- `src/App.tsx`: app boot, settings hydration, mode routing
- `src/views/`: Main and Mini views
- `src/components/`: visual and interaction components
- `src/lib/playback/`: playback contracts, store, mock and Tauri sources
- `src/lib/collection/`: Crate records, stats, Wrapped
- `src/lib/i18n/`: English/Russian dictionaries
- `src-tauri/src/media/`: SMTC/MPRIS adapters, poller, artwork
- `src-tauri/src/settings/`: settings authority
- `src-tauri/src/collection/`: Crate persistence and history
- `src-tauri/src/window/`: window modes and Mini behavior
- `scripts/`: local installers, release collection, changelog extraction
- `.github/workflows/`: CI and tag-driven release

## Verification
```bash
npm run lint
npm run build
npm run test:frontend
npm run fmt:rust
npm run clippy:rust
npm run test:rust
```
